title: Research sprint goal: The kb's first fitness tests: a held-out answer rate and parked review gaps
goal: Answer the two goal questions whose kb coverage is weak, from official sources only, as facts in kb/public/agents/ topics (extend an existing topic where one fits): (1) how a held-out evaluation set is kept separate from the tuning set so it measures generalisation, and why a failing held-out row is not moved into the tuning set (an ML evaluation or RAG evaluation page on learn.microsoft.com); (2) what bounds a backlog that grows from every review finding becoming a work item: WIP limits, a definition of ready, outcome-based done (the Kanban Guide or the Scrum Guide). The two kb/_self questions (how rag.py eval exits, where the query log store records lookups) need no outside facts: kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/querylog.md answer them.
